summary: The @gyomu/ai-react package provides React-specific abstractions and hooks for integrating Gyomu's AI chat capabilities into user interfaces. It serves as a bridge between standard UI components and the Gyomu communication protocol by handling message transformation and standardized error management.
responsibilities: Manage the lifecycle and state of Gyomu-powered chat sessions.
Transform UI-layer messages into internal protocol-compatible formats.
Provide standardized error handling for network and API interactions.
Implement normalized status tracking for chat operations.

capabilities.name: Chat Session Management
capabilities.description: Provides React hooks to initiate, control, and observe chat sessions within UI components.

capabilities.name: Message Normalization
capabilities.description: Utilities to transform and extract content from multi-part UI messages into consistent application-level formats.

capabilities.name: Resilient API Communication
capabilities.description: Configurable fetch wrappers that automate error parsing and handle response exceptions for reliable backend interaction.

capabilities.name: Status Coordination
capabilities.description: Standardizes raw backend status signals into a predictable state interface for UI rendering.

designDecisions: Uses a hook-based architecture to encapsulate session state and side effects.
Decouples UI message structures from the internal Gyomu transport protocol via explicit mapping layers.
Implements a centralized error handling strategy using typed exceptions to differentiate public-facing errors from internal failures.
usageGuidance: Use the provided React hook as the primary entry point for managing chat state rather than interacting with transport layers directly.
Utilize the provided mapping utilities when interfacing with standard AI SDK message formats.
Always wrap network requests with the provided fetch utilities to ensure consistent error boundary management.
